title: Keep appropriate personal information glanceable in Always On

statement.en: Keep nonsensitive personal information glanceable in Always On when it makes sense.
statement.ja: 適切な場合、sensitiveでないpersonal informationをAlways Onでglanceableに保つ。

conditions: Useful examples include workout updates on Apple Watch and timely travel or ride updates on iPhone.
exceptions: People can turn off Always On when they don't want information to remain visible.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Always On experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるAlways Onの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。
